articles.summary: SaaS platforms don't fit a single mold when it comes to payments pricing. An early-stage vertical software company needs simple, flexible tools to experiment and iterate. A platform moving upmarket needs granular cost control and the ability to offer sophisticated pricing to enterprise customers. And as AI features reshape how platforms monetize, that diversity is only going to increase.

articles.summary: A failed payment request means a Stripe user did all the work to get a customer to pay, but lost the sale because of us. We never want this to happen. To minimize failed payments for our users, we target 99.9995% reliability. Maintaining that level of reliability while processing around 1.6% of global GDP is an exceptionally difficult technical challenge, but most of us who join Stripe’s infrastructure teams are here because we love technical challenges.
